positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified
positions.frame: what is the verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and against what was it checked?
positions.why: src-1 states the calibration event in prose (instrument now calibrated at 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates, holding across the observing band); src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument and calibration facts as catalog fields. All three converge on one directional read — a settled, verified calibration state for a named instrument — delivered in the same flat instrumental register (per the register pass's InstrumentLogRegister mint) and the same present/realis/concrete temporal footing. No tension: the bullet points are a compressed restatement of the prose claim rather than a competing account.
